design.decision: Bid as high as the hand can exactly make, then duck overtricks.
design.opponent: Revealed at scoring; opponents can push extra tricks on the team.
design.rationale: Gives Exact a bid-tension version: exact bids pay more when they are large, so the safe low exact bid is not dominant.
